prompt: A photorealistic medium shot, 16:9, like a frame grabbed from a 1990s regional TV broadcast on Betacam SP: clean but slightly soft colour, a faint comet-tail smear trailing the bright studio lamp. A masked presenter sits behind a chipped laminate desk, caught mid-gesture: he presses a glass of red wine against the knit where his mouth would be, the wine tilting, while his other hand points sideways at something off screen. His head is a deep red-brown lambswool balaclava with crown decreases and stray fibres, one continuous unbroken knitted surface over the whole face. A large white felt ring is sewn around the face, slightly puckering the wool; inside it sits a small solid pillar-box-red felt triangle with rounded corners at two o'clock, on the right side of the image. A rumpled black suit, white shirt buttoned to the collar over the hood's neck, cuffs over plain black wool gloves. Behind him a creased orange curtain; one key light from frame right; blank papers and a coffee ring on the desk. Thanks.
